The related interest income for staff car loans and staff personal loans in 2010 was KShs 1,289,155 (2009 – KShs 1,237,777) and KShs 136,162 (2009 – KShs Nil) respectively. In the normal course of business, transactions have been entered with certain related parties at commercial terms. (b) Remuneration to directors is disclosed under Note 10.
